CREATE CONSTRAINT issue_number_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Issue) REQUIRE n.number IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT user_login_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:User) REQUIRE n.login IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT comment_id_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Comment) REQUIRE n.commentId IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT label_name_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Label) REQUIRE n.name IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT pull_request_id_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:PullRequest) REQUIRE n.prId IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT meta_key_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Meta) REQUIRE n.key IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT subcategory_name_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Subcategory) REQUIRE n.name IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT solution_text_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Solution) REQUIRE n.solutionText IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT workaround_text_unique IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Workaround) REQUIRE n.workaroundText IS UNIQUE

UNWIND $issues AS iss MERGE (i:Issue {issueId: iss.issueId}) SET i.number = toInteger(iss.number), i.title = iss.title, i.bodyText = iss.bodyText, i.createdAt = iss.createdAt, i.updatedAt = iss.updatedAt, i.closedAt = iss.closedAt, i.state = iss.state, i.authorLogin = iss.authorLogin
UNWIND $users AS user MERGE (u:User {login: user.login}) SET u.name = user.name, u.company = user.company
UNWIND $links AS link MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: link.issueId}), (u:User {login: link.login}) MERGE (i)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(u)
UNWIND $issueIds AS issueId MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: issueId})-[r:ASSIGNED_TO]->() DELETE r
UNWIND $labels AS label MERGE (l:Label {name: label.name}) SET l.description = label.description, l.color = label.color
UNWIND $links AS link MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: link.issueId}) MATCH (l:Label {name: link.name}) MERGE (i)-[:HAS_LABEL]->(l)
UNWIND $reactions AS reaction MERGE (r:Reaction {content: reaction.content, issueId: reaction.issueId, userLogin: reaction.userLogin}) ON CREATE SET r.commentId = reaction.commentId
UNWIND $issueIds AS issueId MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: issueId}) MATCH (r:Reaction {issueId: issueId}) WHERE r.commentId IS NULL MERGE (i)-[:HAS_REACTION]->(r)

UNWIND $comments AS c MERGE (comment:Comment {commentId: c.id}) SET comment.bodyText = c.bodyText, comment.createdAt = c.createdAt, comment.authorLogin = c.authorLogin WITH comment, c MATCH (i:Issue {issueId: c.issueId}) MERGE (i)-[:HAS_COMMENT]->(comment)
